title: channel@1
description: A way to reach you (#65): it only transports. deliver(item, ctx) hands the provider what the hub rendered and says delivered with the provider's acknowledgement, stalled, timed out or conflict; receive(ctx) returns the answers, the threads seen and any conflict the provider reports, each answer's proof passed on unchanged for the hub to check.

slot.description: The hub slot the fill declares itself for.

revision.description: The kit revision the fill was built against.

kind.description: What the channel reaches: a device that signs, a chat app, email or a text message.

steps.description: Whether the channel can draw a plan's steps (#1580). Only one that says true gets a card with a plan as its steps, its hash and buttons; any other gets that card as the item view, saying where to answer.
